'''Ieine''' is part of the [[Knitting Circle]] in the [[Kin]] based in [[Ebou Dar]]. 

== Appearance ==
She is tall and almost as dark as the Sea Folk, with dark hair.

== Activities ==
Her Saidar strength is {{opsl|37}}, strong enough to become Aes Sedai. However, she failed to complete her test for Accepted, and was put out of the White Tower.

She is one of the Kin that accompanies [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] to the Rahad to find the [[Bowl of the Winds]]. She holds the shield on [[Ispan Shefar]] after the [[Gholam]] attack.

As the majority of Kinswomen in Ebou Dar she presumably travelled firstly to the [[farm]] and later to [[Andor]].
